action: Verified Cargo stable DirectorySource checksum failure semantics from official rustdoc and linked stable source only.
finding: A missing/unreadable or unparsable .cargo-checksum.json aborts DirectorySource::update and denies loading any package in the directory source. For parsed metadata, Source::verify hashes each file explicitly listed in checksum.files; inability to hash a listed file or SHA256 mismatch returns an error. This verifies fail-closed behavior at two distinct stages, but does not establish treatment of extra on-disk files omitted from checksum.files.
exact_tested_scope: Official stable Cargo DirectorySource rustdoc and cargo/sources/directory.rs source; no Cargo execution, dependency repository, second version/project, initial vendoring path, compilation, or runtime test.
continuation: On the next invocation, after fresh required-control bootstrap and SHA-only freshness validation, read only current open_source LATEST and inspect exactly the same official Cargo stable DirectorySource source around Source::verify to determine whether extra on-disk files absent from checksum.files can influence package contents without rejection. Preserve exact tested scope; do not execute Cargo, inspect a dependency repository, broaden to initial vendoring/provenance, or start a second semantic leaf.
